correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 32x128 distinct two-deletion incidence matrix from all 21 retained-coordinate pairs per seven-bit word. Independently checked all six explicit codebooks satisfy every row load<=L and cardinalities (5,11,16,21,26,32). Independently checked every 128 pointwise nonnegative rational dual inequality for each L and strict upper bounds 256/45, 666/59, 452/27, 1160/53, 1430/53, 2340/73, each strictly below the next integer. For L=2, independently checked all 32 primal inequalities, all 128 variable bounds, and rational objective 666/59. Thus finite exact certificates prove both integer optima and fractional gap 17/59 without trusting a solver or extrapolating.
